_doc: The art slots the game is still missing, and status notes on art it already ships. Read by art/tools/art_manifest.py. `wanted` slots are requests, not approvals: ids are asset ids, never player-facing names (names are Rylee's). `loop` is the loop number in docs/plans/release-1-0/LOOPS.md. `native` is [w, h] in game pixels at the 32 px tile. Edit here, then run `python3 art/tools/art_manifest.py brief --all` to regenerate art/requests/. `round` is the art/source folder this round of sheets is saved in; bump it when a new round starts.

sprite:shade.note: five shade families and the Ember Warden (the last Section's boss) all wear it

sprite:barrel-mimic.note: the Silt Warden wears the barrel mimic; a warden wants its own picture (slot boss-warden-well or boss-warden-fire, once Sections 2-4 follow canon)

sprite:root-tangle.note: the Root Warden wears the root tangle; a warden wants its own picture (slot boss-warden-well, once Section 2 follows canon)

tile:cellar-wall.note: walls and floors read as one cobbled texture on generated floors (cottage#166, seen again 2026-10-29 at 1280x720)
